test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

One string was handed ______ by the musician to the shopkeeper for repair.
solution:
The correct answer is **"over."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Handed over"** is a commonly used phrasal verb meaning to give
